3652-5006-5231-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
3652-5006-5231-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {R}
Repeat.

5254-8095-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-8095-8122.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
5254-8095-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

147-2171-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
147-2171-8095.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2113-4222-7937.description:
Activate Badgey by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgey triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Badgey.
Repeat.

3532-3761-5078-7913.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3761-5078-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

1799-4050-5359-7817.description:
Activate Paradox Shaper by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and the Gnomes, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1818-4399-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1818-4399-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

647-4289-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
647-4289-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
647-4289-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

3259-4302-4460-4509.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
3259-4302-4460-4509.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

891-3055-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1169-3490-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1169-3490-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1085-2511-4053.description:
Cast Chronozoa by paying {3}{U}. It will enter without a time counter on it due to Solemnity.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Chronozoa.
When Chronozoa dies, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself that also enter with no time counters on them due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2 using a token copy of Chronozoa instead.

4316-5078-5901.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Artist's Talent's first ability triggers. Choose not to discard a card.
Repeat

2438-3020-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
2438-3020-6701.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it triggers, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature returned in step 4.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-1322-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

1368-1414-4856.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six other cards in your graveyard, plus an additional four cards if Brain Freeze is in your graveyard.
1368-1414-4856.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its escape cost by exiling three cards besides Brain Freeze from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Cast Brain Freeze either from your hand by paying {1}{U}, or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Brain Freeze's storm ability triggers, creating at least two copies of Brain Freeze targeting yourself, and any remaining copies targeting an opponent.
Resolve each Brain Freeze, causing yourself to mill nine cards and, if applicable, an opponent to mill three cards for each Brain Freeze remaining.
Repeat.

977-1414-2051-2350-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two land cards in your hand.
977-1414-2051-2350-5751.description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Cast Chromatic Star from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {G}, returning at least two land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Chromatic Star by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Chromatic Star triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4871-5256-5433.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure.
4871-5256-5433.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Goblin token.
When the Goblin dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Goblin's power.
Repeat.

1881-1965-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Omarthis on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

527-979-3812.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 9 or greater.
527-979-3812.description:
Activate Likeness Looter by paying {3}, causing it to become a copy of Selvala.
Activate Likeness Looter using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {7}{G}{U}.
Activate Likeness Looter by paying {3}, causing it to become a copy of Simic Ragworm.
Activate Likeness Looter using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2837-3049-3750-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Sophina do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other nontoken creatures that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
2837-3049-3750-4050.description:
Declare Sophina and at least tive other nontoken creatures as attackers.
Sophina triggers, creating at least six 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste or six 3/1 Dog creature tokens due to Jinnie Fay.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five creature tokens, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
